videos.title: Lam：原子尺度工程時代
watchFor: 沉積增加材料、蝕刻選擇性移除材料，兩者需要搭配。
原子層操作著重循環控制；不可把每一循環必定等於完整原子層。
高深寬比及三維結構使均勻性與選擇性同時重要。
watchForEn: Deposition adds material while etching removes selected material; the processes work together.
Atomic-layer methods use controlled cycles; do not assume every cycle necessarily equals one complete atomic layer.
High-aspect-ratio and 3D features make both uniformity and selectivity important.

related.transfer: GAA 依靠內間隔及釋放；CFET 再加入互補元件的垂直隔離。
related.transferEn: GAA depends on inner spacers and release; CFET adds vertical isolation between complementary devices.
related.difference: 本課驗收重點是片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異；「奈米片內側間隔層製作」則以側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation; Nanosheet inner-spacer fabrication treats lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
practice: 畫出環繞閘極奈米片電晶體與奈米片內側間隔層製作之間的材料或資料交接
用「環繞閘拓撲」作為兩課比較起點，列出一項相同與一項不同邊界
選一項片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異的觀察，說明還需哪個奈米片內側間隔層製作證據才可放行
practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and Nanosheet inner-spacer fabrication
Use draw the gate-all-around topology to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation and state which additional Nanosheet inner-spacer fabrication evidence is needed for acceptance
related.title: 奈米片內側間隔層製作

courses.summary: 以環繞閘極奈米片電晶體為入口，追蹤片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異。地圖定位公開機構的代表據點，幫助理解研究與供應鏈分工；課程取材跨多個原始來源，不主張此處是唯一發明地或實際量產現場。
courses.summaryEn: Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors explores inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation. The map locates a public institutional reference to explain research and supply-chain roles. This course draws on multiple original sources and does not claim an exclusive invention site or actual production location.
